bluemarble.hint: Drag to turn it, scroll to come closer. Let go and it keeps turning on its own.
bluemarble.line.sunCity: The sun is directly above {city} right now.
bluemarble.line.sunSea: The sun is directly above open water right now, at {lat}°, {lon}°.
bluemarble.line.night: {n} of {total} cities are in darkness right now.
bluemarble.line.quakeCount: The Earth shook {n} times in the last day.
bluemarble.line.issCity: Several people are passing over {city} right now at {kmh} km/h.
bluemarble.line.issSea: The ISS is {alt} km above open water right now, moving at {kmh} km/h.
bluemarble.line.kpCalm: The Earth's magnetic field is quiet right now.
bluemarble.line.kpStorm: A magnetic storm is coming (Kp {kp}). The aurora reaches further south than usual.
bluemarble.line.aurora: Somewhere near the poles, the sky is shaking green right now.
bluemarble.line.issPass: {when} — at {clock}, people pass {el}° above your head. Look up and you can see them.
bluemarble.line.issPassNone: The ISS does not pass over this place in the next 24 hours.
bluemarble.line.pastDay: This is Earth on {date}. That day’s clouds, where they were.
bluemarble.line.pastQuake: The Earth shook {n} times that day. The largest was magnitude {mag}, near {where}.
bluemarble.line.pastQuiet: Nothing above magnitude 4.5 shook anywhere that day.
bluemarble.line.pastSun: At this hour that day, the sun stood above {lat}°, {lon}°.
bluemarble.line.sats: {n} objects are circling above you right now. Almost all of them were put there by people.
bluemarble.line.wind: The solar wind is blowing at {speed} km/s. It reaches here in {min} minutes.
bluemarble.line.moon: This is the Moon. No air, so the edge is cut like a blade.
bluemarble.line.moon2: Here a day lasts two weeks, and so does the night.
bluemarble.line.mars: This is Mars. A day is 24 hours 37 minutes — it brightens a little slower than home.
bluemarble.line.mars2: Even right now, a few things we sent are still driving around up there.
bluemarble.credit.mars: Mars map: Solar System Scope (CC BY 4.0)
bluemarble.line.dawn: {n} major cities are between 2 and 5 in the morning right now. Someone is awake there too.
bluemarble.line.apod: Today NASA picked “{title}” as the picture of the day.
bluemarble.line.dusk: Along this line the sun is setting right now. On the other side it is rising.
bluemarble.line.duskCity: The sun is setting around {city} right now.
bluemarble.deep.lineNow: The continents as they are now. Drag left and the plates run backwards.
bluemarble.deep.line: Earth {ma} million years ago — before the continents reached where they are now.
bluemarble.deep.how: There are no photographs of this time. This is plate motion run backwards; all we know is where water met land, so nothing else is coloured in.
bluemarble.link.copied: Copied the link to this spot. Anyone who opens it sees the Earth from here.
bluemarble.card.title: Earth on {date}
bluemarble.card.credit: NASA Blue Marble · GIBS · USGS · NOAA — KarmoLab Blue Marble
bluemarble.radio.ready: On air in {n} places — tap a ring
bluemarble.radio.fail: Could not fetch the station list
bluemarble.radio.hint: Tap a ring to hear that town
bluemarble.radio.dead: Nobody is on air there right now
